F1: getById()` returns the org-aware model, whose `isEnabled()` is false while the org is disabled. If you hide a provider on login while its org is disabled, both checks return false and the login cache is not invalidated; nothing else ever clears it, so the hidden provider shows up again on the login page once the org is re-enabled.
F2: The `"alias"` cleanup really is wrong, but it only affects test teardown and nothing shows it breaking other tests, so it is test cleanup rather than a defect that must be fixed before merge.
